help:
Usage: complete [OPTIONS] [message] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Agent Hub completion API

Arguments:
  message  Message to send

Options:
  --message <str>             Message to send without relying on positional
                              ordering
  -a, --agent <str>           Agent slug
  -M, --model <str>           Model override (e.g.
                              cloudflare/qwen2.5-coder-32b). Uses @mention
                              injection to override agent's default model.
  -p, --project <str>         Project ID
  -s, --source <str>          Source client  [default: st-cli]
  -S, --session <str>         Continue existing session
  -m, --memory / --no-memory  Enable memory injection  [default: memory]
  -g, --memory-group <str>    Memory group ID
  --task-type <str>           Optional task type label (e.g. wake, heartbeat)
  --thinking <str>            Thinking level:
                              minimal|low|medium|high|ultrathink
  --skip-cache                Bypass response cache
  --stream                    Stream response via SSE
  --trace <str>               Trace ID for event correlation
  --roles <str>               Comma-separated prompt roles to include
  -i, --image <str>           Image file path(s) for multimodal input
  -A, --audio <str>           Audio file path(s): WAV, MP3, AIFF, AAC, OGG, or
                              FLAC
  -f, --file <str>            Read message from file
  -t, --timeout <float>       Optional HTTP read-timeout ceiling in seconds.
                              Omit to wait for completion.
  --raw                       Output raw JSON
  --install-completion        Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion           Show completion for the current shell, to copy
                              it or customize the installation.
  --help                      Show this message and exit.

usage.when: send an authorized completion request through Agent Hub

argv:
import json
from st_sdk.runtime import describe_app
from agent_hub_st.__main__ import OWNED_APPS
print(json.dumps(describe_app(OWNED_APPS['complete'], 'complete')))
